chapters.label: Live: Yerevan 2024
chapters.text: Yerevan, 2024. Barcelona play Sporting in a futsal Champions League semi final. Four all, then Matheus Rodrigues scores the fifth. Barcelona win five four!

chapters.label: How he does it
chapters.text: Here’s how he does it. He runs at the defender, fast. One foot pushes the ball out, then snaps it back in. The defender is fooled, and he shoots!

chapters.label: Watch again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Out and back in, one quick touch. The defender leans the wrong way.

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn. Tricks work best when you do them at speed, and with a purpose: get past and score!
